policy.balance: Balance uses the Pythagorean values of each normalized name component's first letter; whitespace and hyphen delimit components.
policy.karmic_lessons: Karmic Lessons are the missing Pythagorean values 1 through 9 in the full normalized name.
policy.hidden_passion: Hidden Passion is every Pythagorean value tied for the highest letter-frequency count; ties are preserved rather than broken arbitrarily.
policy.normalization: The canonical TR/EN PythagoreanNameNormalizer is reused; unsupported characters are rejected rather than silently deleted.

remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Karmic Debt remains a separate unfinished requirement and is not implied by this contract.
